name: Sudowrite
tagline: Sudowrite is an AI creative writing assistant purpose-built for novelists and screenwriters, offering tools specifically designed for fiction — including a Story Engine that builds full narrative arcs, a Describe tool that generates multi-sensory scene details, and a Brainstorm mode for developing characters and plot points. Unlike general writing AI, Sudowrite is trained with literary fiction in mind and avoids the generic marketing-copy tone of other tools. Published authors and writing teachers have become vocal advocates.
